673-20(gi): yul la brgyas mi brjod//sangs rgyas bka' dang mchod pa'i rgyun//'da'
673-21(gi): bar ma yin rtag tu gnas/gnas mchog gzungs ma sems mi spang
674-1(gi): bdag gzhan byang chub sems mi gsad/yongs su ma sbyangs tshad ma sbyor//
674-2(gi): tshogs lam don gyi lam gtor la//gsang ba'i brda dang dbang mi smra//phung
674-3(gi): po dngos med tshas mi brcas//dad ldan mi ldog phyag rgya brtag/bka' la
674-4(gi): tshad ma sbras mi gzhal/dam rdzas gzungs ma dregs pa bsten//rnal 'byor
674-5(gi): mi brtag gsang sngags bzlas//bla ma dam tshig dam rdzas lung //cung zad
674-6(gi): 'dasa na de yis ni//dkyil 'khor tshogs kyi bskang gso bya//dad pa'i sgo
674-7(gi): gsum sdom la gnas//sems kyi rten pa skye med brtags//gshin rje gshed
674-8(gi): kyi dka' thub bsrungs//brtul zhugs rig pa'i rdzas la spyad//sems kyi
674-9(gi): 'khor lo rtag tu blta//gdug pa'i snying po dbang du bsdu//las kyi rnam
674-10(gi): grangs du ma brtsam//gshin rje'i phyag rgya don dang sbyar//de nas yang bcom
674-11(gi): ldan 'das kyis che ba'i don du 'di bshad do//e ma'o gsang ba'i gsang
674-12(gi): bcud 'di//'khor lo rgyal po mtshon chen 'di//rgyad rgyal me long rgyal
674-13(gi): mtshan 'di//las kyi rgyal po mtshon cha yin//khyun chen nam mkha' dbang
674-14(gi): sdud yin//seng ge rtsal bsgoms sems can zil gyis gnon/dregs pa'i
674-15(gi): rgyal pos bde ba'i gnas la bgrod//lhun po nam mkha' rin chen rgya mtsho me/
674-16(gi): gsang rgyud bshad pa 'phrul gyi bka'/shes rab dbang gi rtsal mi ldan/
674-17(gi): 'khor gyi rigs dang rigs min kun//pa yi snying po bcud bsdus pa'i//snga
674-18(gi): tshogs 'phrul gyi sbyor ba 'di//shes rab dbang gi rtsal dang sbyor//sangs
674-19(gi): rgyas bka' yi byin brlabs nas//gsang ba'i bdag pos rab tu bshad//
674-20(gi): phyag rgya chen po'i bde ba bstan/byin gyis brlabs dang ldan pa yis/log
674-21(gi): pa'i sems 'chang 'dul byed bka'//gsang lam sbyor ba'i dag pa 'di/
675-1(gi): dpal bzhin ce nag po 'khral 'khor rgyal mtshan me mng gcyad kyi rtyal ba
675-2(gi): sangs rgyas stobs dpag med pa'o//mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas dang /
675-3(gi): gshin rjze gshed po'i dge 'dun rnams//lha dang lha min gsang ba'i bdag
675-4(gi): ma mo myos byed khrag 'thung 'bum//mkha' 'gros skyo byed byad stems sam/
675-5(gi): bdud dang srin po sha za'i tshogs//srin mo las byed gnod sbyin kru//mu
675-6(gi): stegs ke ka byad stems gnyan//nyi bla dbang phyug dkor srungs gza'//rgyal
675-7(gi): po sngags pa ging srog bdag/stobs chen 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs/mu
675-8(gi): stegs log pa'i nus pa 'joms//kun kyang gshin je gshed po'i 'khor/
675-9(gi): rab tu mi bsrun 'jig rten dregs//bde ba'i 'khor du 'dus pa rnams/
675-10(gi): bde ba'i snying po lam can 'di//khro bo rgyal po dregs pa 'khor//khro bo gshin
675-11(gi): rje gshed po ni//sangs rgyas sku gsung thugs kyi bcud//bsdus nas dzo rje
675-12(gi): lam las phyung //gsang ba'i pho brang gnas su bskyil/snying med thugs kyi
675-13(gi): snying po las//'khor gyi khro tshogs pho mo rnams//lnga brgya dus kyi snyigs ma la/
675-14(gi): nga yi 'phrul gyi gsang rgyad 'di//ma 'ongs dam can sgrub byed na//ba yang
675-15(gi): dam las mi yol srung //'khor gyi dregs pa pho mo dang //dbang chen sangs
675-16(gi): rgyas tshos srungs rnams//lnga brgya dus kyi snyigs ma la/skal ldan bsgrub pa'i
675-17(gi): bcud len dang //rgyad kyi snying po 'dzin pa la//de tshe gshin rje gshed po
675-18(gi): yis//dam tshig 'byung dang thugs brtse ba'o//de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis
675-19(gi): gsungs pa la 'khor thams cad rjes su yi rangs te mngon par bstod do//
675-20(gi): 'khrul 'khor rgyal mtshan gyi me long gi byad las/yongs su gtad pa'i le'u ste
675-21(gi): bshad pa'i rgyad chen po gshin je thams cad 'byung ba 'khrul 'khor rgyal
